title: SmartAgri Researchers Survey Six Locations for Multispectral UAV Research in Rice Fields
excerpt: Three researchers from the Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) at Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM), Achmad Tijani, Prima Hestiawan, and Muhammad Furqon Ashari, surveyed six agricultural locations. body:
Three researchers from the Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) at Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM), Achmad Tijani, Prima Hestiawan, and Muhammad Furqon Ashari, surveyed six agricultural locations. This activity marks the initial phase of research on the use of multispectral UAV in smart agriculture. The team explored rice fields with potential for data collection.

The research develops a _response-based management zone_ model based on plant physiological characteristics, soil physics, and soil chemistry. The multispectral sensor on the UAV records light reflection across several spectrum ranges to observe the diversity of field conditions. The image data will be combined with plant physiological characteristics and soil properties in model development.

The researchers were accompanied by SmartAgri research assistants Fahmi Arsyad, Mutiara Alifia Ramadhanty, and M. Fajar Ridho. The team visited agricultural land in Sewon, Gilangharjo, Jomboran, Glagahwangi, Sidowayah, and Klaten Kota. The assessment included land area and uniformity, availability of flight area, and conditions surrounding the locations.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1120-1-f6e400fc-73e0-4ed4-b649-bb58cae41113-2-1030x773.webp)

The survey at Sewon recorded approximately 40 minutes of travel time and newly planted rice crops. However, an area for UAV flight could not yet be determined. In Gilangharjo, the crops were also relatively uniform and newly planted, but no field was available to support flight operations. The team also noted strong winds at that location.

Jomboran and Glagahwangi have large areas, but land use is diverse. Some land is planted with corn, some with rice, and some remains unworked. Glagahwangi has a field, while the flight area in Jomboran has not yet been determined. In Sidowayah, all observed land is planted with rice and a field is available, although the planting pattern is not yet uniform.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1120-2-tempimagelabqot-1030x773.webp)

Klaten Kota has a large area, a field, and a uniform planting pattern. The team also found a high-voltage transmission network at approximately 70 meters in height. The presence of this network is a consideration in determining airspace and safety for UAV flight operations.

The survey results provided the team with an initial comparison of conditions at each location. Crop uniformity, flight area, wind conditions, and the presence of electrical networks become considerations in selecting locations and organizing data collection. The multispectral data to be collected is expected to support the development of a model for managing agricultural land.

## Linkage with SDGs

-   **SDG 2 – Zero Hunger.** The survey was conducted on several rice field agricultural lands in preparation for agricultural research. This research is related to efforts to obtain information to support land management. The survey activity has not yet shown impact on production results.
-   **SDG 9 – Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure.** The research prepares for the use of multispectral UAV and the development of data-based models. The combination of UAV imagery with soil characteristics is part of the development of methods for agriculture. This linkage is at the research and development stage.

original.body:
Tiga peneliti Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM), Achmad Tijani, Prima Hestiawan, dan Muhammad Furqon Ashari, menyurvei enam lokasi pertanian. Kegiatan ini menjadi tahap awal penelitian penggunaan UAV multispektral di bidang pertanian cerdas. Tim menjajaki lahan padi yang berpotensi digunakan untuk pengambilan data.

Penelitian tersebut mengembangkan model _response-based management zone_ berdasarkan karakteristik fisiologis tanaman, fisik dan kimia tanah. Sensor multispektral pada UAV merekam pantulan cahaya pada beberapa rentang spektrum untuk mengamati keragaman kondisi lahan. Data citra itu akan dipadukan dengan karakteristik fisiologis tanaman dan tanah dalam pengembangan model.

Para peneliti didampingi asisten peneliti SmartAgri Fahmi Arsyad, Mutiara Alifia Ramadhanty, dan M. Fajar Ridho. Tim meninjau lahan pertanian Sewon, Gilangharjo, Jomboran, Glagahwangi, Sidowayah, dan Klaten Kota. Penilaian mencakup luas dan keseragaman lahan, ketersediaan area penerbangan, serta kondisi di sekitar lokasi.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1120-1-f6e400fc-73e0-4ed4-b649-bb58cae41113-2-1030x773.webp)

Survei ke Sewon mencatat waktu tempuh sekitar 40 menit dan tanaman padi yang baru ditanam. Namun, area untuk menerbangkan UAV belum dapat ditentukan. Di Gilangharjo, tanaman juga relatif seragam dan baru ditanam, tetapi belum tersedia lapangan untuk mendukung penerbangan. Tim turut mencatat angin kencang di lokasi tersebut.

Jomboran dan Glagahwangi memiliki area yang luas, tetapi penggunaan lahannya beragam. Sebagian lahan ditanami jagung, sebagian padi, dan sebagian lainnya belum diolah. Glagahwangi memiliki lapangan, sedangkan area penerbangan di Jomboran belum ditentukan. Di Sidowayah, seluruh lahan yang diamati ditanami padi dan tersedia lapangan, meski pola tanamnya belum seragam.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1120-2-tempimagelabqot-1030x773.webp)

Klaten Kota memiliki area yang luas, lapangan, dan pola tanam yang seragam. Tim juga menemukan jaringan SUTET dengan ketinggian sekitar 70 meter. Keberadaan jaringan tersebut menjadi pertimbangan dalam menentukan ruang dan keselamatan penerbangan UAV.

Hasil peninjauan memberi tim pembanding awal atas kondisi tiap lokasi. Keseragaman tanaman, area penerbangan, kondisi angin, dan keberadaan jaringan listrik menjadi pertimbangan dalam memilih lokasi serta menyusun pengambilan data. Data multispektral yang nantinya dikumpulkan diharapkan mendukung pengembangan model pengelolaan lahan pertanian.

## Keterkaitan dengan SDGs

-   **SDG 2 – Tanpa Kelaparan.** Survei dilakukan di sejumlah lahan pertanian padi sebagai persiapan penelitian pertanian. Riset ini berkaitan dengan upaya memperoleh informasi untuk mendukung pengelolaan lahan. Kegiatan survei ini belum menunjukkan dampak terhadap hasil produksi.
-   **SDG 9 – Industri, Inovasi, dan Infrastruktur.** Penelitian menyiapkan penggunaan UAV multispektral dan pengembangan model berbasis data. Penggabungan citra UAV dengan karakteristik tanah menjadi bagian dari pengembangan metode untuk bidang pertanian. Keterkaitan ini berada pada tahap penelitian dan pengembangan.
